subject.title: [Feature]: Auto-discovery of agent configurations from external workspaces

question: Should OpenClaw add core trusted external-workspace agent config discovery, or keep agent registration explicit through `agents.list` and `agents.create/update/delete` while improving import or batch workflows separately?
rationale: The requested behavior adds new public config, filesystem scanning, trust boundaries, and live routing semantics that cannot be resolved as a routine bug fix from source inspection alone.

options.title: Keep explicit registration
options.body: Continue using central config and explicit RPC/CLI mutation by default, and only add narrower import or batch ergonomics if a concrete missing API remains.

options.title: Design trusted discovery
options.body: Define a core discovery contract for trusted roots, file names, validation, merge precedence, reload behavior, session isolation, and audit/security proof before implementation.

options.title: Route through bundles or plugins
options.body: Defer runtime scanning and explore portable Agent Bundles, workspace capability docs, or plugin/ClawHub packaging before adding a core scanner.

recommendation.title: Keep explicit registration
recommendation.body: Continue using central config and explicit RPC/CLI mutation by default, and only add narrower import or batch ergonomics if a concrete missing API remains.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the strongest history signal on the `agents_list` discovery surface and central agent config/runtime boundaries.
